mapper.select: SELECT i.id AS item_id,i.kind,i.project_id,v.title,v.id AS version_id,v.version_number, i.source_generation,i.revision,i.status,i.verification FROM preparation_item i JOIN preparation_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=i.current_version_id AND v.version_number=i.version_number WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{itemId}

SELECT id,root_item_id,root_kind,root_title,root_project_id,change_kind, previous_version_id,previous_version_number,previous_generation,previous_revision,previous_status,previous_verification, current_version_id,current_version_number,current_generation,current_revision,current_status,current_verification,created_at FROM preparation_knowledge_event WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{eventId}

SELECT t.id AS task_id,t.manifest_json,d.target_item_id,d.target_version_id,v.version_number AS target_version_number FROM ai_task t JOIN ai_candidate_decision d ON d.owner_id=t.owner_id AND d.task_id=t.id AND d.status='ADOPTED' JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=d.owner_id AND v.item_id=d.target_item_id AND v.id=d.target_version_id WHERE t.owner_id=#{owner} AND t.purpose='KNOWLEDGE_DRAFT' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_preparation_source s JOIN preparation_item selected_input ON selected_input.owner_id=s.owner_id AND selected_input.id=s.source_item_id AND selected_input.kind=s.source_kind WHERE s.owner_id=t.owner_id AND s.task_id=t.id AND ( s.source_item_id=#{rootItemId} OR (#{rootKind}='PROJECT' AND selected_input.kind='FACT' AND selected_input.project_id=#{rootItemId})
OR (#{rootKind} IN ('FACT','PROJECT') AND selected_input.kind='EXPRESSION'))) AND t.id > #{after} ORDER BY t.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT source_item_id AS item_id,source_version_id AS version_id,source_kind AS kind, source_version_number AS number,source_title AS title,ordinal FROM ai_preparation_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 6

SELECT
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preparation_item WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{itemId}) EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_item WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{itemId}) FALSE
mapper.sql: i.id,i.revision,i.event_id,i.source_domain,i.source_kind, COALESCE(i.preparation_source_item_id,i.knowledge_source_item_id) AS source_item_id, COALESCE(prep.title,knowledge.title) AS source_title, COALESCE(i.preparation_source_version_id,i.knowledge_source_version_id) AS source_version_id, COALESCE(prep.version_number,knowledge.version_number) AS source_version_number, i.dependency_kind,i.via_fact_item_id,via.title AS via_fact_title,i.via_fact_version_id, via.version_number AS via_fact_version_number,i.task_id,i.target_item_id,target.title AS target_title, i.target_version_id,target.version_number AS target_version_number,i.depth,i.parent_impact_id,i.created_at, i.choice,i.reason,i.resolution_target_version_id,i.resolution_target_revision,i.decided_at

FROM preparation_knowledge_impact i JOIN preparation_knowledge_event e ON e.owner_id=i.owner_id AND e.id=i.event_id LEFT JOIN preparation_version prep ON prep.owner_id=i.owner_id AND prep.item_id=i.preparation_source_item_id AND prep.id=i.preparation_source_version_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version knowledge ON knowledge.owner_id=i.owner_id AND knowledge.item_id=i.knowledge_source_item_id AND knowledge.id=i.knowledge_source_version_id LEFT JOIN preparation_version via ON via.owner_id=i.owner_id AND via.item_id=i.via_fact_item_id AND via.id=i.via_fact_version_id JOIN knowledge_version target ON target.owner_id=i.owner_id AND target.item_id=i.target_item_id AND target.id=i.target_version_id
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.event_id=#{eventId} AND i.propagation_pending=1 AND i.depth=(SELECT MIN(frontier.depth) FROM preparation_knowledge_impact frontier WHERE frontier.owner_id=#{owner} AND frontier.event_id=#{eventId} AND frontier.propagation_pending=1) ORDER BY i.depth,i.task_id,i.source_domain,i.preparation_source_item_id,i.knowledge_source_item_id,i.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preparation_knowledge_impact WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND propagation_pending=1)
mapper.update: UPDATE preparation_knowledge_impact SET propagation_pending=0 WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND id=#{impactId} AND propagation_pending=1

UPDATE preparation_knowledge_impact i SET i.revision=1,i.choice=#{choice},i.reason=#{reason},i.resolution_target_version_id=#{targetVersionId}, i.resolution_target_revision=#{targetRevision},i.decided_at=#{now} WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.target_item_id=#{itemId} AND i.id=#{impactId} AND i.revision=#{expected} AND i.revision=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_item k WHERE k.owner_id=i.owner_id AND k.id=i.target_item_id AND k.metadata_revision=#{targetRevision} AND k.current_version_id=#{targetVersionId})
